'''Ceran Tol''' was an [[artist]] in the [[Age of Legends]].

==History==
Ceran Tol created a piece of art called [[Tempo of Infinity]] in the Age of Legends. In the [[Third Age]], [[Graendal]] is impressed that [[Sammael]] has Ceran's work.{{ref/book|6|23}}
